paragraphs.text: Gwenna , the Eyes of Gaea , was an elven druid and scout from Dominaria during the time of the Sylex Blast .
Gwenna was an elf who helped Harbin when he arrived on Argoth .

During the Sylex Blast , Gwenna was on the mainland, attacking Urza 's shipyards in Korlis . She felt the ground tremble beneath her and heard the cry of Gaea as Argoth , her land, died. Gwenna noticed the sea was gone, leaving only broad patches of mud and rock. She realized what that meant - a tsunami. She shouted for her warriors to flee to the hills inland and broke into a loping run. She was halfway up the nearest hill when the first great waves, each the size of a small mountain, broke against the coastline, smashing everything in their path.
About a century after the war, Gwenna sacrificed herself to help Temken and the other Survivors of the Sylex Blast to rebuild their society.
